rules.name: Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM pass-the-hash attacks where an adversary uses a password hash instead of plaintext password
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "lateral-movement" or Message contains "pass-the-hash" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
